prompt.zh-TW: 晨光印刷的營業收入 T 字帳在年底有貸方餘額 {{money:vars.rev}}。這個數字會出現在哪裡？
prompt.en: Morning Light Printing’s revenue T-account shows a credit balance of {{money:vars.rev}} at year end. Where does this figure appear?

text.zh-TW: 損益表的營業收入列，之後經由本期淨利併入未分配盈餘
text.en: On the revenue line of the income statement, later reaching unappropriated retained earnings through profit for the period

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。收入與費用科目是「這一期」的流量，結算進本期淨利；資產負債表只列結算後的未分配盈餘。
feedback.en: That is right. Revenue and expense accounts are flows for the period and close into profit for the period; the balance sheet shows only the resulting unappropriated retained earnings.

text.zh-TW: 跳過損益表，直接在資產負債表的權益那一段多出一列「營業收入」
text.en: Directly in the equity section of the balance sheet, as a line called revenue

feedback.zh-TW: 你知道收入最後會讓股東權益增加，方向正確。但它不是直接列上去，而是先和成本、費用相抵得到本期淨利，再併進未分配盈餘。
feedback.en: You are right that revenue ultimately increases equity. But it does not go on directly; it is first netted against costs and expenses to give profit for the period, which is then added to unappropriated retained earnings.

text.zh-TW: 現金流量表最後一列算出的期末現金
text.en: In cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period on the statement of cash flows

feedback.zh-TW: 營業收入和現金常常一起動，所以會這樣聯想。但賒銷的收入還沒變成現金；現金流量表看的是現金的進出，不是收入。
feedback.en: Revenue and cash often move together, hence the association. But revenue from credit sales has not become cash yet; the statement of cash flows tracks cash movements, not revenue.

explanation.zh-TW: {{option:o_a1b2}}描述了收入科目餘額的去向。{{option:o_c3d4}}跳過了結算為本期淨利這一步；{{option:o_e5f6}}把收入和現金混為一談。
explanation.en: {{option:o_a1b2}} describes where a revenue balance goes. {{option:o_c3d4}} skips the step of closing into profit for the period; {{option:o_e5f6}} confuses revenue with cash.
